feature: TikTok CSV Import Optimization - Batch Processing
workflow_rationale: This is an enhancement to existing functionality. The CSV import already works but needs performance optimization through batch processing to handle larger datasets efficiently. No new features, just internal processing improvements.

phases.name: Batch Processing Infrastructure
phases.description: Add helper methods for building multi-row INSERT SQL and refactor the main import loop to collect rows into batches

subtasks.description: Add buildMultiRowInsertSql() helper method to GenericCsvImporter for constructing multi-row INSERT statements with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
subtasks.notes: Added buildMultiRowInsertSql() helper method to GenericCsvImporter.php. The method constructs multi-row INSERT statements with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE support, auto-detects mysqli bind types, and returns SQL, types string, and flat params array for use with prepared statements. Committed as ece1c50.

subtasks.description: Add importBatch() method that processes a batch of mapped rows - inserts posts, resolves IDs, inserts metrics, handles hashtags
subtasks.notes: Implemented importBatch() method with: multi-row INSERT for posts, bulk post ID resolution, batch metrics_history insert, and processHashtagsBatch() for efficient hashtag handling. Reduces DB round-trips from 3+ per row to ~4 per batch.

subtasks.description: Refactor import() method to use batch collection pattern - collect rows into batches of 100, call importBatch() when batch is full
subtasks.notes: Refactored import() method to use batch collection pattern. Collects mapped rows into $batch array, calls importBatch() when batch reaches 100 rows, and processes any remaining rows after the file loop. Reduced from 85 lines to 25 lines by removing individual prepared statement processing. Commit: dcc804c

phases.name: Core Batch Database Operations
phases.description: Implement multi-row INSERT for posts table with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, and efficient batch ID resolution

subtasks.description: Implement insertPostsBatch() - multi-row INSERT INTO posts with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE for batch of mapped rows
subtasks.notes: Implemented insertPostsBatch() method with multi-row INSERT INTO posts with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE. Method uses GREATEST() for metric columns to preserve highest values on duplicates. Refactored importBatch() to use the new dedicated method for better modularity.

subtasks.description: Implement resolvePostIdsBatch() - batch lookup of post IDs using WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ((?, ?), (?, ?), ...)
subtasks.notes: Implemented resolvePostIdsBatch() method with optimized tuple IN syntax: WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ((?, ?), ...). This is more efficient than multiple OR conditions. Refactored importBatch() to use the new method. Commit: f9c3980

subtasks.description: Implement insertMetricsHistoryBatch() - multi-row INSERT INTO metrics_history for batch of post metrics
subtasks.notes: Implemented insertMetricsHistoryBatch() method for multi-row INSERT INTO metrics_history. Follows same pattern as insertPostsBatch() - uses buildMultiRowInsertSql() helper, proper type casting for integers, early return for empty input. Updated importBatch() to use the new dedicated method instead of inline code.

phases.name: Hashtag Processing Optimization
phases.description: Optimize hashtag processing to use batch operations instead of per-hashtag-per-post queries

subtasks.description: Implement collectHashtagsFromBatch() - extract all unique hashtags from batch with their associated post data
subtasks.notes: Implemented collectHashtagsFromBatch() helper method that extracts all unique hashtags from batch with aggregated metrics (posts, views, likes) and post-hashtag links for junction table. Refactored processHashtagsBatch() to use the new helper. Returns structured array with 'aggregates' and 'links' keys. Commit: 94be463

subtasks.description: Implement upsertHashtagsBatch() - batch upsert to hashtag_performance table using multi-row INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
subtasks.notes: Implemented upsertHashtagsBatch() method that performs batch upsert to hashtag_performance table using multi-row INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE. Method uses increment expressions (total_posts + VALUES(total_posts)) to accumulate metrics. Returns hashtag_id map for post_hashtags linking. Refactored processHashtagsBatch() to use the new dedicated method. Commit: 2653c82

subtasks.description: Implement linkPostHashtagsBatch() - batch INSERT IGNORE into post_hashtags junction table
subtasks.notes: Implemented linkPostHashtagsBatch() method for batch INSERT IGNORE into post_hashtags junction table. Extracted logic from processHashtagsBatch() into dedicated reusable method. Follows established patterns from insertPostsBatch() and insertMetricsHistoryBatch().

subtasks.description: Refactor processHashtagsBatch() to use new batch methods and replace old per-hashtag processHashtags()
subtasks.notes: Refactored processHashtagsBatch() to use the three new batch methods (collectHashtagsFromBatch, upsertHashtagsBatch, linkPostHashtagsBatch). Removed legacy per-hashtag processHashtags() method that made 2-3 DB queries per hashtag. The batch approach now reduces queries from ~3 per hashtag per post to just 3 per entire batch. Added early return optimization and enhanced documentation. Commit: e9ac2fe

phases.name: Large File and Memory Management
phases.description: Add support for very large CSV files with chunked transaction commits and memory monitoring

subtasks.description: Add configurable batch size and chunk commit threshold - const BATCH_SIZE = 100, const CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE = 5000
subtasks.notes: Added private const BATCH_SIZE = 100 and private const CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE = 5000 as class constants with docblocks. Updated import() method to use self::BATCH_SIZE instead of local variable. Commit: f491be4

subtasks.description: Add chunked transaction commits - commit and restart transaction every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows for files >10k rows
subtasks.notes: Implemented chunked transaction commits for large files (>500KB / ~10k rows). Uses CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE (5000) threshold to commit and restart transactions, preventing timeouts and reducing memory pressure. Small files continue using single transaction for atomicity.

phases.name: TikTokCsvImporter Optimization
phases.description: Apply the same batch processing optimizations to the legacy TikTokCsvImporter for consistency

subtasks.description: Refactor TikTokCsvImporter to use batch processing pattern - add same helper methods or extract shared base class
subtasks.notes: Refactored TikTokCsvImporter to use batch processing pattern matching GenericCsvImporter. Added all helper methods (buildMultiRowInsertSql, resolvePostIdsBatch, insertPostsBatch, insertMetricsHistoryBatch, mapTikTokRow, importBatch), batch constants (BATCH_SIZE=100, CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE=5000), BOM stripping in normalizeHeader, toInt helper, and chunked transaction commits for large files. PHP syntax verification blocked by sandbox but code follows exact pattern of working GenericCsvImporter.

verification.instructions: 1. Use content_tracker_enhanced.csv if available, 2. POST to /api/import/csv, 3. Verify hashtag_performance and post_hashtags tables populated

Tests verify hashtag_performance table population, post_hashtags junction table links, cross-platform hashtag separation, and metrics aggregation. Commit: 7310136. subtasks.description: Performance test: Import 1000-row CSV and verify completes in <5 seconds

verification.instructions: 1. Generate or use 1000-row test CSV, 2. Time the import, 3. Target: <5 seconds total

subtasks.notes: Created performance test artifacts: generate_1000_rows.php (deterministic CSV generator), PerformanceTest1000Rows.php (PHP integration test with timing, memory tracking, database verification), test_performance_1000_rows.sh (bash/curl API test), PERFORMANCE_TEST_VERIFICATION.md (comprehensive manual verification guide). Target: <5 seconds for 1000 rows. Tests verify posts and metrics_history counts, memory usage, and throughput. Commit: 5e896ec. subtasks.description: Error handling test: Import CSV with malformed rows, verify graceful skip and continue

verification.instructions: 1. Create CSV with some rows missing required fields, 2. Import, 3. Verify skipped count incremented, valid rows still processed

subtasks.notes: Verified: All test artifacts in place (malformed_rows_test.csv, MalformedRowsIntegrationTest.php, test_malformed_rows.sh, MALFORMED_ROWS_VERIFICATION.md). Test verifies graceful skip of malformed rows (wrong column counts, empty/whitespace post_id) while continuing to process valid rows. Expected: 7 processed, 5 skipped. Originally committed as 3ee5754.
